result.detail: Independent review of this work is still needed and must come from another seat. Upstream specifications [artifact:prj-811978f57e.interface-spec.a1] and [artifact:prj-811978f57e.microarchitecture.a1] are approved with review records [evidence:prj-811978f57e.interface-spec.e1] and [evidence:prj-811978f57e.microarchitecture.e1]. The formal_spec is submitted because the interface spec requires a formal proof, so formal.run and formal.cover now apply. The formal model of the decode and byte merge is written independently of the RTL (explicit address compares, AND/OR mask) so a bug in one cannot hide behind the other. Only the default parameters (ADDR_WIDTH=8, DATA_WIDTH=32) are supported, which section 1 of the interface spec permits; the formal block hard-codes them.
